name: Adonijah
role: David's son who claimed the throne
whenBasis: In David's reign, ≈1010–970 BC, counted back from Solomon as Thiele and most chronologies do.
summary: David's fourth son, by Haggith, handsome and never once rebuked by his father. As David lay old and cold, he exalted himself, saying, “I will be king!”, gathered chariots and runners, and won over Joab and Abiathar; he held a feast at the Stone of Zoheleth. Nathan and Bathsheba moved David to have Solomon anointed, and Adonijah fled to the altar. Spared, he later asked for David's nurse Abishag as wife, and Solomon had him executed.
body: Zadok, Benaiah, Nathan and the mighty men are not invited to his feast, nor is Solomon. The guests hear the trumpets and shouting from Gihon and scatter.
Solomon hears in his request for Abishag a claim to the kingdom, since the king's women went with the throne: “you might as well request the kingdom for him.”
